d:
An unexpected call can lead anywhere when Turtleman is on the case. Ernie Brown Jr. teams up with Neal James and Team Turtle for animal rescue missions involving snakes, turtles, raccoons and mink. Every call brings a fresh challenge, an unpredictable encounter and a wild creature in need of help.
From snake catching and turtle rescues to unexpected wildlife encounters, each adventure calls for quick thinking and steady nerves. What begins as one simple request can quickly become a wild mission, with surprises waiting around every corner.
